summary: 35 units reviewed (37-71). src tokens match the input and text/ (ch05.01.md) matches lines_deva for every unit. 5 errors and 37 minor issues (31 with machine patches). Main findings: Hindi 'फिर भी' for punar api (58); kalkam labelled m. nom. (39); additions in English (70 'variations on', 71 '(ends)', 67 'Thus.'); jīrṇa/bhāvita/siddha renderings inconsistent; flags in 49 (garagaṇḍa/galagaṇḍa) and 63 (arbī) missing; flags 44/51 use 'unclear' as a suggestion. Text flags: the draft has 21 flags in 15 units (38,43,44,47,51,54,56,57,58,59,60,62,67,69,70), not 28 in 21; all other flags are plausible corrections, src kept the printed token, and the corrected form is in words (except 43). Low-confidence units 44, 51, 54, 57, 58, 59, 63, 67 are honestly low; 38 should be low too. GROUPING: 68 (lead-in bhavati cātra) + 69 + 70 should be one unit (lead-in plus one verse; metre confirms 69+70 are two 16-syllable half-verses once vamanānāṃ is restored); 71 is the colophon (not verse). 56-59 are one continuous procedure (decoction, ghee, leha, anupāna) and 38-42 / 60-61 are linked, but no regrouping is needed there.
